title: Karga Notify
subtitle: Automated Grade Tracker & Notification System for University Students
description: Karga Notify is a C# desktop application that automatically monitors university grade announcements and sends instant desktop notifications when new exam results are published. Students can track midterm, final, and resit grades without manually checking the student portal.
longDescription:
Karga Notify is a desktop application built for university students to automate the tedious process of checking grade announcements. Instead of repeatedly logging into the student portal, the app handles the entire login flow automatically — navigating to the grade page, scraping current results, and comparing them against previously stored data.

When a new grade is announced or an existing one changes, the app immediately sends a desktop notification containing the course name and the new grade value. Newly announced passing grades are highlighted in green and failing ones in red in the course list, making it easy to spot changes at a glance.

The app features credential saving so that login details are pre-filled on every session — the student only needs to solve the CAPTCHA. A dedicated Settings page offers 6 different color themes. The Help page links to the GitHub documentation, and the About page contains information about the developer and the application.

contentBlocks.heading: Project Overview
contentBlocks.subheading: Never Miss a Grade Announcement Again
contentBlocks.content:
Karga Notify is a desktop application designed to save university students from repeatedly logging into their student portal to check for new grade announcements. The app automates the entire process — from login to grade extraction — and notifies the user instantly when something changes.

Users can track midterm (vize), final, and resit (bütünleme) exam results for all their enrolled courses. When a new result is published, a desktop notification appears with the course name and grade value. The course list updates in real time, with newly announced grades highlighted by background color so changes are immediately visible.

The app is not affiliated with any official university institution. It was developed by Yasir Alrawi and all rights belong to Alrawi.

contentBlocks.heading: How It Works
contentBlocks.content:
**Step 1 — Save Your Credentials (Optional)**
On first use, you can save your student portal login credentials in the app. On every subsequent session, the login form is pre-filled automatically — you only need to solve the CAPTCHA. If you choose not to save credentials, you can enter them manually each time.

**Step 2 — Click START**
Press the START button to launch the automated browser. The app opens the university login page and navigates through the portal automatically.

**Step 3 — Log In**
Log in using your student account. After successful login, no further manual interaction is needed — the app takes over.

**Step 4 — Automatic Navigation**
After login, the portal homepage opens. The app waits 10 seconds, then automatically navigates to the Grade Information (Not Bilgisi) page.

**Step 5 — Allow Notifications**
Within 20 seconds of reaching the grade page, you must grant notification permission in the browser. If you miss this window, click FREEZE, then START again and repeat the login. Once permission is granted, the browser runs in the background automatically.

**Step 6 — Live Grade Monitoring**
After another 10 seconds, your current grade data appears in the app. From this point, the app continuously monitors for changes. When a new grade is announced:
- A desktop notification is sent with the course name and grade value.
- The course appears in the list with a colored background: green for passing, red for failing.
- If the latest announced grade is a pass, it also appears persistently in the bottom-left panel.

contentBlocks.heading: Settings & Themes
contentBlocks.content:
The Settings page offers 6 different color themes for UI personalization, allowing users to customize the look of the application. From Settings you can also reset all application data or restart the program.

Available options on the Settings page:
- **6 color themes** — switch between different visual styles
- **Reset** — clears all saved data and resets the app to its initial state
- **Restart** — closes and relaunches the application
